matchup_notes: Detroit and Chicago were first and second, respectively, in the NFC North; both were 8-2.
Chicago beat the New Orleans Saints 21-13 on November 22 and had won five straight games.
Detroit beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 31-21 on November 22 for its sixth straight win.
The game was scheduled for Thursday, November 26, at 1:00 p.m. ET on CBS.
